description: Reads the sign-up form of one webinar as the participant sees it, top to bottom: every field with its slot, its visible label, its type (text, checkbox, textarea, dropdown or a hidden field), whether it is required, and whether it really renders on the participant page. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it before changing a field (that is wi_change_registration_fields) and when the host asks which data the form collects or why a field is missing. Not for the provider names an autoresponder expects (that is wi_change_webinar_autoresponder). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_get_registration_fields
title: Read the registration form fields
